About

Meet your hairdresser – Virginija

“Beauty is in the details.”

Virginija is a hairdresser in Kaunas who has completed several hairdressing academies, including Ro Ro courses, and attended many haircutting and hair colouring seminars. She keeps learning, so she can offer both classic and modern looks.

Clients call her “a true specialist in her field” – attentive and a great listener who not only cuts beautifully but also shares plenty of tips on caring for your hair at home. Reviews often mention the cosy atmosphere: people say they leave the salon feeling happy.

If you enjoy a warm chat and a neat hairstyle – drop by, we’ll have a good time.

  • Several hairdressing academies, including Ro Ro courses
  • Many haircutting and colouring seminars

Frequently asked questions

How much does a haircut cost at Hairdresser Virginija in Kaunas?

+

Women’s haircuts from 15 €, men’s haircuts from 20 € (23 € with a hair wash), children’s haircuts and ends trims 15 €, restyle haircuts 25 €, haircut with beard styling 25 €.

How do I book an appointment?

+

You can book online via Treatwell at any time or call +370 654 60937.

Where is the salon and how do I get there?

+

The salon is at Pramonės pr. 15A in Kaunas (Dainava district), easy to reach from Dainava, Petrašiūnai, Šančiai, Eiguliai and Žaliakalnis. Buses 33 and 41 stop nearby.

What are the opening hours?

+

Monday to Saturday 10:00–19:00. Closed on Sundays.

Do you cut children’s hair?

+

Yes. A children’s haircut takes about 45 minutes and costs 15 €. We make the visit calm and comfortable for little ones.

Do you offer hair colouring?

+

Colouring starts with a consultation (30 min, 5 €) to assess hair condition, length and density and agree on the colour and final price.
